upbear.definition:
v. t. To bear up; to raise aloft; to support in an elevated
   situation; to sustain.

upbeat.definition: n. an unaccented beat (especially the last beat of a measure)
upbeat.translation:
n. 弱拍, 上升, 兴旺
a. 上升的, 乐观的

upbeats.definition:
plural of upbeat
n. an unaccented beat (especially the last beat of a measure)
upbeats.translation:
(upbeat 的复数) n. 弱拍, 上升, 兴旺
a. 上升的, 乐观的

upborne.translation: a. 被托起的, 被支撑着的

upbound.definition: s heading in any direction that is conventionally up

upbraid.translation: vt. 谴责, 责骂, 申斥

upbraided.translation: v. 责备, 申斥, 谴责( upbraid的过去式和过去分词 )

upbraider.definition: n. someone who finds fault or imputes blame
upbraider.translation: n. 责备者, 斥责者, 申斥者, 责骂者

upbraiding.definition:
n a severe scolding
v express criticism towards
upbraiding.translation:
a. 叱责的, 谴责的
n. 叱责, 谴责

upbraids.translation: v. 责备, 申斥, 谴责( upbraid的第三人称单数 )

upbreed.definition: v. t. To rear, or bring up; to nurse.

upbringing.definition: n. properties acquired during a person's formative years

upbringings.definition:
plural of upbringing
n. properties acquired during a person's formative years

upbuilding.translation: (upbuild 的现在分词) vt. 建立

upbuilds.translation: (upbuild 的第三人称 -s形式) vt. 建立

upburst.definition:
n. The act of bursting upwards; a breaking through to the
   surface; an upbreak or uprush; as, an upburst of molten matter.
upburst.translation: n. 向上的迸发,上冲,猛增
